summary: Love, choices, time travel. Shape two lives. Every choice matters.
description:
🦋「Reviver」is A  narrative puzzle game about love and choices🦋
Dive into a world where every small decision changes lives. See how choices link together and shape the stories of two people. Embark on a journey through time and discover how your actions make a big difference in their lives.

🎻【Symphony of Two Souls】🎵
「Reviver」unfolds a series of emotionally rich scenes, portraying the life journey of two protagonists from their youthful days to senectitude. In the game, every interaction and choice subtly influences their destinies, revealing deep connections between individuals.

🕹️【Innovative Interactive Gameplay】🎮
Every object and environment in the game comes to life with rich animations, providing an immersive interactive experience. This unique interaction style not only enhances the game's entertainment value but also deepens the immersion and emotional resonance of the story.

🗺️【Blend of Puzzle and Exploration】🧩
Explore over 50 puzzles and mini-games closely tied to the storyline, with each challenge presenting an opportunity to delve deeper into the narrative, unveiling secrets and clues hidden in the everyday.

🎨【Visual Feast of Hand-Drawn Style】🖌️
「Reviver」adopts exquisite hand-drawn illustrations, blending emotionally rich interactive animations with detailed environmental design. Each scene tells its own story, silently conveying narratives through interaction and animation.

🕰️【Embark on a Journey Through Time Together】🌍
Invite you to join「Reviver」and embark on a journey through different eras. In this adventure, experience how small interactions tell profoundly moving stories in silence, and explore a profound journey about love, choices, and destiny.
